about: The named exceptions (PR1; the goal's "写死数值只剩带理由的例外表"): every literal a sheet still writes, with the reason it is not a parameter -- a component's own geometry, a diagram's drawing, a wrap point. scripts/check_ui_parameters.py refuses a literal without a reason here, and a reason no sheet uses any more. Keys are the ratchet's: sheet | media | selector | property | value. The `census` list names what the census probe (handtuned_census.py) finds and the gate does not count: structure, behaviour constants, an icon's or an engine's own geometry.

census.reason: a share column is 1/N of the table: arithmetic, one rule per count
a figure column shrinks to its content (the table's 1 % idiom)
a skeleton's bars are its own drawing: a placeholder's lengths
visually hidden: the 1 px box and its -1 px margin (structure)
the skip link waits off screen until it is focused (structure)
the arrow glyph tilts toward its target on hover: the glyph's own geometry
the accessibility sheet's scoped overrides (forced colours, reduced motion) are excepted (plan, C1)
forced colours and reduced motion must win (plan: stays)
[hidden] always hides: the attribute's meaning (structure)
an engine's own drawing (the lattice art): its geometry, as an icon's

a named constant in its owner -- a cadence, a cap, a page, a retention, a window, a step list -- is behaviour, not a design value (plan: stays); the display lengths are the library's (SHORT, LIST_PAGE)
an icon's own 24-grid geometry (plan: stays)
a timer is behaviour: a debounce, a chord window, a clock's tick (plan: stays)
0 is structure: a scroll to the top, a measure from the origin
measured at the origin: 0 is structure
an ISO instant's own parts: the date (10), to the minute (16), the year (4), the month
a generated local id's length
a middle cut (head ... tail) that CSS cannot draw: a workspace's name, a session's label
a rationale folds past 240 characters behind More

the review answer's bounds: the service's request (web.py MAXIMUM_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES) and each answer owner's own (64*1024 the Analyst brief, 256*1024 the CRO assessment); behaviour, a test keeps the three equal to their owners'
a command's label past 48 characters is not offered as a command
the risk formations page by forty rows
a diagnostic title in a console warning
a composition shows six slices and Other: the categorical palette's size (dataviz)
a choice list shows its first eight chosen as chips, the rest as a count
a list shows its first few and says how many more: the owner's cap (behaviour)
an exact plan's targets: the first twelve, then how many more (the rest are in the plan)
